title: Authentication release review handoff
prompt:
Samira asked for the v2.4 authentication release review to be unblocked. Two open changes look similar. Determine which one needs the missing owner review, arrange the review, reconcile the release handoff notes, and respond to Samira with the verified disposition and the identity of the reviewer you requested. This is coordination work; do not approve, merge, close, or change source.

The linked service frontends are available for browsing, search, editing and visual verification. Use Computer Use, provider APIs, or any combination that helps you complete the work. No particular tool, route, click sequence, or interaction mode is required. Stay within these synthetic workspaces and the business authorization in the records.

Finish with a concise outcome report and a JSON object named result_facts containing: release, reviewer, disposition. Use the record identifiers you actually verified.

required_steps.purpose: Read the request and distinguish its release scope.
Compare both open changes and changed paths.
Inspect current review requests to avoid duplicates.
Request the responsible security reviewer on the production change.
Update the existing handoff notes with evidence and pending status.
Reply to the accountable owner and verify the final state.

files.content: Release service. No code changes or merges are authorized by the operations workflows.

documents.title: Release review policy
documents.content: For production auth changes, CODEOWNERS is authoritative. Request the listed person before scheduling release. Samira owns coordination. A requested review is not an approval. Staging documentation is outside this release.

messages.body: Please pick up the missing security-owner review for v2.4. Resolve ownership from CODEOWNERS, update the v2.4 release handoff, and send me a status reply. Only I need this update.
